statement: The DFS describes a USD 1 million annual TETRA lease maintenance fee before commercial operations.
limitation: The filing does not identify the next payment date or a complete hold abandonment grant-clawback or rights-expiry cash path at the case cutoff.

statement: The DFS publishes a 100 percent project post-tax unlevered forecast and a rounded annual cash-flow row.
limitation: The whole-project forecast does not identify cash already spent or a dated remaining option-world path at the cutoff.

statement: The reported cash-flow table uses relative periods and omits year zero.
limitation: The filing does not map those labels to the case cutoff calendar dates or the status-quo payment dates.

statement: The disclosed project cash-flow row and NPV are labelled post-tax and unlevered.
limitation: This establishes the reported project-model basis only and does not supply a dated incremental tax bridge.

statement: The DFS reports economics on a 100 percent SWA project basis and identifies a 55 percent Standard Lithium and 45 percent Equinor JV.
limitation: This does not establish that 100 percent project FCFF or an ownership percentage is distributable parent cash.

statement: The 2024 annual information form says Equinor solely funds the first USD 40 million of SWA development costs and later capital expenditures are pro rata.
limitation: The public filing does not disclose how much of that amount remained at the cutoff or the dated capital-call and funding schedule.

statement: The SEC-filed release says SWA Lithium LLC closed a USD 225 million DOE grant to support Phase 1 construction.
limitation: The release does not disclose grant draws compliance milestones cost sharing or whether funds are accessible corporate cash at the cutoff.

statement: The DFS states that no binding contractual arrangements are currently in place in its economic-model assumptions.
limitation: This is not a complete legal FID contract cancellation or permit-rights schedule and cannot establish an executable build or defer option.
